Chinese (Simplified)(zh-CN):
感谢各位于日前给予希望孤儿院的关心与鼓励。

本院很高兴向大家宣布，在各界的关心与支持下，本院目前的营运问题以获得改善并将继续营运，原先预计的停运安排也将取消。

未来，本院将持续致力于提供孩子们安全、稳定且温暖的成长环境，并妥善运用每一份善心资源，为孩子们创造更好的学习与生活条件。

希望孤儿院 敬启

Thank you for the concern and encouragement you have recently shown Hope Orphanage.

We are pleased to announce that, with the care and support of the community, our current operational difficulties have improved and the orphanage will continue operating. The previously planned closure has therefore been cancelled.

Moving forward, we will remain committed to providing the children with a safe, stable, and warm environment in which to grow. We will also make responsible use of every generous contribution to create better learning and living conditions for them.

Sincerely, Hope Orphanage

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-CN):
感谢各位长期以来对希望孤儿院的关心与支持。

由于近年来营运经费持续短缺，加上院舍维护及儿童照护支出不断增加，本院目前已面临严重的财政困难。经多方评估后，希望孤儿院预计将于近期停止营运。

目前，本院正积极与相关政府单位及儿童福利机构联系，妥善安排院内孩子们后续的生活与安置事宜，希望尽可能降低此次事件对孩子们造成的影响。

希望孤儿院 敬启
English (United States)(en-US):
Thank you for your long-standing care and support for Hope Orphanage.

Due to persistent shortages in operating funds in recent years, along with increasing building maintenance and childcare expenses, the orphanage is currently facing serious financial difficulties. After extensive evaluation, Hope Orphanage is expected to cease operations in the near future.

We are currently working closely with relevant government departments and child welfare organizations to properly arrange the children's future care and placement, in hopes of minimizing the impact this situation may have on them.

Sincerely, Hope Orphanage

今日（8月1日）接近清晨时分，位于郊外的希望孤儿院突发火灾。所幸事发当时以有几名孤儿院里的职员起身，他们第一时间发现事故向消防局报了案，并合理疏散在孤儿院里的孤儿们。消防员也随后赶到将火灾范围限制并扑灭由于职员们迅速的判断，本起火灾并无造成任何人员的伤亡。

English (United States)(en-US):
In the early hours of today (August 1), a fire suddenly broke out at Hope Orphanage, located on the outskirts of town. Fortunately, several staff members were already awake when the incident occurred. They immediately reported the fire to the fire department and evacuated the children in an orderly manner. Firefighters soon arrived, contained the blaze, and extinguished it. Thanks to the staff's quick response, there were no casualties.

Just when it seemed the incident had ended without serious harm, news emerged that the orphanage director, Chen Zhihong, had gone missing. According to several staff members, they had seen the director before going to bed, but after the fire he was nowhere to be found and could not be contacted. Firefighters also found no sign of anyone matching the director at the scene. The matter has been reported to the police and is being treated as a missing-person case.
